-- The CRM's schema. An org is the scope value IAM grants roles in; no table owns it. A company lies in an org, a
-- contact and a deal in a company, a task in a deal. Every row carries its whole containment chain, and each contained
-- table references UNIQUE (id, <chain>) of its container, so a moved company moves its contacts, deals and tasks.

CREATE TYPE deal_stage AS ENUM ('lead', 'qualified', 'proposal', 'won', 'lost');
CREATE TYPE activity_kind AS ENUM ('note', 'call', 'email', 'meeting');

CREATE TABLE companies (
	id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
	org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	name TEXT NOT NULL,
	website TEXT,
	created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
	version INTEGER NOT NULL,
	UNIQUE (id, org_id)
);
CREATE INDEX companies_org ON companies (org_id);

CREATE TABLE contacts (
	id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
	company_id UUID NOT NULL,
	org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	name TEXT NOT NULL,
	email TEXT,
	phone TEXT,
	created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
	version INTEGER NOT NULL,
	UNIQUE (id, company_id, org_id),
	FOREIGN KEY (company_id, org_id) REFERENCES companies (id, org_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX contacts_company ON contacts (company_id);

-- `source` is where a deal came from (a referral, an event), free text; `owner` is the member who owns it.
CREATE TABLE deals (
	id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
	company_id UUID NOT NULL,
	org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	title TEXT NOT NULL,
	value INTEGER NOT NULL,
	stage deal_stage NOT NULL,
	source TEXT,
	owner TEXT NOT NULL,
	owner_label TEXT NOT NULL,
	created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
	version INTEGER NOT NULL,
	UNIQUE (id, company_id, org_id),
	FOREIGN KEY (company_id, org_id) REFERENCES companies (id, org_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX deals_company ON deals (company_id);

CREATE TABLE tasks (
	id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
	deal_id UUID NOT NULL,
	company_id UUID NOT NULL,
	org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	title TEXT NOT NULL,
	due_on DATE NOT NULL,
	assignee TEXT NOT NULL,
	assignee_label TEXT NOT NULL,
	done BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
	overdue BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
	created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
	version INTEGER NOT NULL,
	UNIQUE (id, deal_id, company_id, org_id),
	FOREIGN KEY (deal_id, company_id, org_id) REFERENCES deals (id, company_id, org_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX tasks_deal ON tasks (deal_id);
CREATE INDEX tasks_open_due ON tasks (due_on) WHERE NOT done;

-- Activities are notes on a contact or on a deal. A child table has one parent, so each parent has its own table.
CREATE TABLE contact_activities (
	id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
	contact_id UUID NOT NULL,
	company_id UUID NOT NULL,
	org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	kind activity_kind NOT NULL,
	body TEXT NOT NULL,
	author_label TEXT NOT NULL,
	created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
	created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
	FOREIGN KEY (contact_id, company_id, org_id) REFERENCES contacts (id, company_id, org_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX contact_activities_contact ON contact_activities (contact_id);

CREATE TABLE deal_activities (
	id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
	deal_id UUID NOT NULL,
	company_id UUID NOT NULL,
	org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	kind activity_kind NOT NULL,
	body TEXT NOT NULL,
	author_label TEXT NOT NULL,
	created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
	created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
	FOREIGN KEY (deal_id, company_id, org_id) REFERENCES deals (id, company_id, org_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX deal_activities_deal ON deal_activities (deal_id);

-- The `attachments` collection of a deal, as fileTableSql('attachments', { table: 'deals', … }) writes it.
CREATE TABLE fabrika_files_attachments (
	id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
	owner_id UUID,
	company_id UUID,
	org_id TEXT,
	status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'live')),
	object_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
	size BIGINT,
	content_type TEXT NOT NULL,
	sha256 TEXT,
	original_name TEXT,
	created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
	created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
	deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
	FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, company_id, org_id) REFERENCES deals (id, company_id, org_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL
);
CREATE INDEX fabrika_files_attachments_owner ON fabrika_files_attachments (owner_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX fabrika_files_attachments_removable ON fabrika_files_attachments (created_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR owner_id IS NULL OR status = 'pending';

-- A deal's attachments as rows with a file column, which replace the `attachments` file collection. The framework's
-- 0008 migration copied the collection's files into fabrika_files under their own ids; each one becomes a row here,
-- under the same id.

CREATE TABLE deal_attachments (
	id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
	deal_id UUID NOT NULL,
	company_id UUID NOT NULL,
	org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	file UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES fabrika_files (id),
	name TEXT NOT NULL,
	created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
	created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
	FOREIGN KEY (deal_id, company_id, org_id) REFERENCES deals (id, company_id, org_id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX deal_attachments_deal ON deal_attachments (deal_id);
CREATE INDEX deal_attachments_file ON deal_attachments (file);

-- The files an older instance, still serving during the rollout, wrote after 0008 are copied too, so every row the
-- insert reads has its fabrika_files row: the rows not deleted, not pending, that still have a deal.
SELECT fabrika_files_copy_legacy('attachments');
INSERT INTO deal_attachments (id, deal_id, company_id, org_id, file, name, created_by, created_at)
SELECT s.id, s.owner_id, s.company_id, s.org_id, s.id, COALESCE(s.original_name, 'attachment'), s.created_by, s.created_at
FROM fabrika_files_attachments s
WHERE s.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status <> 'pending';

import { activities } from './src/activities/endpoints'
import { app } from './src/app-kit'
import { attachments } from './src/attachments/endpoints'
import { companies } from './src/companies/endpoints'
import { contacts } from './src/contacts/endpoints'
import { deals } from './src/deals/endpoints'
import { orgs } from './src/orgs/endpoints'
import { MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES } from './src/schemas'
import { overdue, tasks } from './src/tasks/endpoints'

export const contract = app.contract((c) => ({
	api: c.rpc('/api', { orgs, companies, contacts, deals, tasks, activities, attachments }),
	site: c.spa('/', { dir: 'dist/web', access: { action: 'crm.read', over: 'org' } }),
	files: {
		attachments: c.files({ maxBytes: MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES, types: ['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'application/pdf', 'text/plain', 'text/csv'] }),
	},
	jobs: { overdue },
	health: c.health('/healthz'),
}))

import { defineTables } from '@fabrika/db/tables'
import { vocabulary } from '../vocabulary'
import { columns } from './schema.generated'

export const tables = defineTables(vocabulary, columns)({
	companies: {
		scope: { dimension: 'company' },
		actions: { read: 'crm.read', insert: 'crm.write', update: 'crm.write', delete: 'crm.delete' },
		insert: ['name', 'website'],
		update: ['name', 'website'],
		version: 'version',
		createdBy: 'created_by',
	},
	contacts: {
		scope: { dimension: 'contact' },
		actions: { read: 'crm.read', insert: 'crm.write', update: 'crm.write', delete: 'crm.delete' },
		insert: ['name', 'email', 'phone'],
		update: ['name', 'email', 'phone'],
		version: 'version',
		createdBy: 'created_by',
	},
	deals: {
		scope: { dimension: 'deal' },
		actions: { read: 'crm.read', insert: 'deals.write', update: 'deals.write', delete: 'crm.delete' },
		insert: ['title', 'value', 'stage', 'source', 'owner', 'owner_label'],
		update: ['title', 'value', 'stage', 'source'],
		version: 'version',
		createdBy: 'created_by',
		columns: { owner: { write: 'deals.assign' }, owner_label: { write: 'deals.assign' } },
	},
	tasks: {
		scope: { dimension: 'task' },
		actions: { read: 'crm.read', insert: 'tasks.write', update: 'tasks.write' },
		insert: ['title', 'due_on', 'assignee', 'assignee_label'],
		update: ['done', 'overdue'],
		version: 'version',
		createdBy: 'created_by',
	},
	contact_activities: {
		scope: { child: 'contacts' },
		actions: { read: 'crm.read', insert: 'activities.write' },
		insert: ['kind', 'body', 'author_label'],
		createdBy: 'created_by',
	},
	deal_activities: {
		scope: { child: 'deals' },
		actions: { read: 'crm.read', insert: 'activities.write' },
		insert: ['kind', 'body', 'author_label'],
		createdBy: 'created_by',
	},
	deal_attachments: {
		scope: { child: 'deals' },
		actions: { read: 'crm.read', insert: 'deals.write', delete: 'crm.delete' },
		insert: ['file', 'name'],
		files: { file: 'attachments' },
		createdBy: 'created_by',
	},
})
